image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image of a compact audio cassette tape. The casing appears to be transparent or semi-transparent plastic with a bluish tint. Two circular spool hubs are visible on the left and right, connected by a strip of magnetic tape across the center window. There is a label area in the middle and text printed directly on the plastic casing above and below the window. The bottom edge shows the rectangular opening for the tape head and two small notches.
